intent: Technical Brief: Asus ROG Strix G16 2023 System State Baseline
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling due to excessive CPU temperatures during gaming sessions
suggested_solution: Re-paste the CPU with a high-quality thermal paste (e.g., PTM) to ensure even heat dissipation.
Apply Kapton tape to the screw area of the left fan to prevent burning.
Consider upgrading the cooling system or adding additional heat sinks to improve airflow and reduce temperatures.
